<?php

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $c, $r);

for ($i = 1; $i <= $r; $i++) {
    for ($j = 1; $j <= $c; $j++)
        echo str_repeat(" ", strlen($c * $r) - strlen($j * $i) + 1) . $i * $j;
    echo "\n";
}
